title: My Redeemer Lives
summary: The closing hymn, words by President Gordon B. Hinckley. Verse one is a testimony of who Christ is: the living Redeemer, Savior, King and Lord. Verse two says what He is to us: a sure rock, a bright hope, a beacon, the light beyond the veil of death. Verse three turns to prayer, asking for His Spirit, His peace, and the faith to walk the lonely road to eternity.

audience.who: Sung by the congregation; verses one and two speak of Christ, verse three speaks to Him
